title: Multiparameter QFIM I_Q = sum_m gamma_m^2 b_m b_m^T, Zero SLD Incompatibility, and Tight-Frame Optimality
claims: For single-qubit DCP survivor states rho_m(theta), all directional SLDs L_{m, i} are scalar multiples of the same single-qubit operator, so [L_{m, i}, L_{m, j}] == 0 and the multiparameter QCRB has zero quantum incompatibility.
Across M wires, I_Q = sum_{m=1}^M gamma_m^2 b_m b_m^T satisfies Tr(I_Q^{-1}) >= n^2 / Tr(I_Q), with equality iff the weighted columns form an isotropic tight frame I_Q = (Tr(I_Q)/n) I_n.
favorable_controls: 3D skewed frame of equal trace (anisotropy inflation 1.7778x)
